modules.name: Planning
modules.preferred_pattern: usePlanningLayout + CPlanningLayout as default combo; usePlanningGantt + CSmartFilter + CPlanningGantt for custom composition; appId/tableKey are the shared persistence identity; filterFields can use shared CValueHelp through type value-help/isValueHelp; extraTools on the left of standard controls; task rows drag-reorder from table or Gantt timeline and persist through onTaskReorder when needed; row drag-reordering is controlled globally by enableRowReorder and per task by PlanningTaskRecord.reorderable
minimal_state: shared appId/tableKey for variants and layouts
verify: table rows align with Gantt bars
row drag-reorder works from both table and Gantt panes
SmartFilter changes table and Gantt rows
Value Help filters select stable keys and affect visible table/Gantt rows when configured
layout save/load works through the same appId/tableKey
custom buttons render left of standard controls
common_failure_modes: invalid date strings
endDate before startDate
missing app shell route
rendering CPlanningGantt alone and forgetting CSmartFilter
replacing standard controls instead of adding extraTools
allowing group header rows to drag or reordering tasks across different groups
ignoring enableRowReorder false or dragging rows with reorderable false
using deprecated filterAppId/filterTableKey for new code
selected Value Help keys do not match task fields or filtering logic

modules.name: Tree
modules.preferred_pattern: CTreeComp for hierarchy tree/table surfaces with optional split detail pane; combine with CAppPageLayout for shell and CDetailInfoPage or custom detail renderers when the right pane needs rich business details
verify: row selection updates detail or callback
filter/table identity is stable when configured
common_failure_modes: duplicate node ids
passing flat table data when children hierarchy is needed
using a separate detail route when split tree/detail was requested
forgetting min pane width constraints in dense pages
importing from src/components/Tree/CTreeComp instead of orbcafe-ui

shared_rules: Prefer canonical examples before inventing new composition
Use hook README only when public hooks exist
If no public hook exists, use public component plus callbacks
Every delivery should include chosen module, paste-ready import, minimal state, verify checklist, and troubleshooting checklist
